Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.item

package com.epitech.depthdiablo.item
Items: weapons, armor, consumables, passive items, inventory and loot tables.
  • Related Packages

    Description
    com.epitech.depthdiablo
     
  • Class
    Description
    Armor
    An armor the player wears in its portrait slot (GDD 1.3.1, 1.4): it adds its defense bonus to the build of its holder.
    Axe
    The axe: a slow, heavy melee weapon whose blade sweeps a wide arc (GDD 1.6).
    Bow
    The bow family: every bow shoots an Arrow from the centre of its owner (GDD 1.3.1).
    Consumable
    An item used once from the hotbar, such as a potion (GDD 1.3.1, 1.4).
    Equipment
    An item the player equips in a portrait slot: a weapon or an armor (GDD 1.3.1, 2.2).
    ExecutionerRing
    A passive item whose hits finish targets left under a part of their max HP (GDD 1.3.1).
    FireRing
    A passive item that makes every landed hit of its holder burn the target (GDD 1.3.1, 1.4.1).
    FireStaff
    The fire staff: a Mage's staff that casts a Fireball from the centre of its owner (GDD 1.3.1).
    Inventory
    The player's bag (GDD 1.4): 3 hotbar slots that take only consumables, 18 slots that take only passive items, the equipped weapon and the worn armor.
    Item
    Base type of everything the player can carry: weapons, armor, consumables and passive items (GDD 1.3.1).
    ItemEffect
    One line of what an item gives (GDD 1.4), shown when the item is selected in the inventory: a translation key and its value, e.g.
    ItemFactory
    Builds items from data/items.json (Q23, Q129).
    ItemSpec
    The values of one entry of data/items.json (Q93, Q129), typed by its "class".

    An "Axe" entry; same values as a sword.

    An "ExecutionerRing" entry.

    A "FireRing" entry.
    ItemSpec.FireStaffSpec

    ItemSpec.SwordSpec

    ItemSpecReader
    Reads one entry of data/items.json into an ItemSpec (Q93, Q129).
    LeatherArmor
    A leather armor (GDD 1.4).
    LifeStealRing
    A passive item that heals its holder by a part of the damage it deals (GDD 1.3.1).
    MeleeWeapon

    PlainBow

    Potion

    RangedWeapon

    Rarity
    How rare an item is (GDD 1.3.1).

    Staff

    StatRing

    Sword
